name: TeO2 crystal bolometer particle-energy calorimetry near 10 mK
plain_name: TeO2 crystal bolometer particle-energy calorimetry near 10 mK
description: Measure energy deposits using thermal pulses from cryogenic TeO2 absorber crystals in CUORE's low-background bolometer array.

sources.citation: INFN Laboratori Nazionali del Gran Sasso, CUORE

requirements.rationale: The source reports approximately 10 mK operating temperature; this is a nominal point.
Absorbers, thermistors and low-noise thermal readout are indispensable.

missing_information: Bolometer heat capacity, thermal-link conductance, noise, energy calibration, cooling budget, radiopurity and shielding are not proven by these encoded checks.
confirmation_note: Curated bounded procedure from the cited source. User must confirm applicability before an interactive verification. Passing encoded checks does not establish unmodeled performance.
verification_scope: Temperature plus the named indispensable measurement/handling functions; no extrapolation of undocumented performance, pressure, calibration, cleanliness or full facility safety.
